description: Analysis code for the article "Isolating the effect of spatial resolution on absorbed-dose estimation in 177Lu-DOTATATE dosimetry: a noise-free digital phantom study with comparison to measured SPECT/CT" (EJNMMI Physics). It reproduces all tables and figures from the public MRTDosimetry dataset and the authors' derived data (ground-truth maps, segmentation, OpenDose3D dose-rate tables). The code was written with the assistance of a large language model (Claude, Anthropic) and verified by the authors.
